title: Japanese Chicken Chirashi Bowl
description: A healthy and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring chicken and rice, perfect for a weeknight dinner. Chirashi means 'scattered' in Japanese, describing the way the ingredients are arranged on top of the rice.
instructions: Cook the Japanese short-grain rice according to package instructions.
In a small saucepan, combine sushi vinegar, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Grill or pan-fry the chicken until cooked through, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, sliced chicken, grated daikon, and sliced shiitake mushrooms.
Drizzle the sushi vinegar mixture over the top of the rice mixture and toss to combine.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
